description: Counts a project's tests by state (active, skip, fixme, todo, expectedToFail, notLoaded) and by tag and annotation, from the test files, without running them. Use it first, for questions such as how many tests are skipped, or which files or tags have the most skipped tests; use find_tests to list the tests themselves. states, tags and grep count only the tests they match. groupBy "file" or "tag" adds the counts of each file or tag, sorted by name and paged with limit and cursor; a test with no tag is in no tag group. Example: {"states": ["skip", "fixme"], "groupBy": "file"}.

description: Lists a project's tests that match filters, read from the test files without running them: each with its id, full name, file and line, state, skip reason and condition, and tags by default. Use it for questions such as which tests are skipped and why, which tests carry @smoke, or where a .only was left in; use test_summary for counts and get_tests for every key of a few ids. Filters combine with AND; a list matches any of its values. fields picks other keys of the test records (id is always there). Answers are paged: follow nextCursor, or narrow the filters. Example: {"states": ["skip"], "withoutReason": true}.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous answer, for the next page. Keep the other arguments the same.

directory.description: A folder inside the project to scan, relative to its root, such as "packages/web". Default: the root.

fields.description: Keys of each test record to return, besides id. Default: fullName, relativeFilePath, lineStart, state, reason, condition, tags.

framework.description: The test runner. Default: the one the server was started with.

grep.description: Keeps tests whose fullName (describe titles and title joined with " > ") matches this regular expression, ignoring case.

only.description: true keeps tests that use .only, or are in a describe that does.

patterns.description: Globs of the test files, relative to `directory`, such as ["tests/**/*.spec.ts"]. Default: the ones the server was started with.

states.description: Keeps tests in one of these states.

tags.description: Keeps tests with one of these tags, written as in the titles, such as "@smoke".

withoutReason.description: true keeps tests that don't run and give no reason.

description: Returns every key of the tests with the given ids, with the scan diagnostics about them, read from the test files without running them: location, describe path, state and where it is set, condition, reason, tags, annotations, comments above the test, parameters and body hash. Use it after find_tests or test_summary, for the details of up to 20 tests. Ids come from find_tests and stay the same when a test moves to another line, but change when its title, describe or file changes; ids not in the current scan are returned in notFound.
